subject: Re: Kickoff: BiGG - synthetic sparse graphs for the index teams
body:
Status + one honest trade-off.

Repro: done. Benchmarks match the released results on the DD and G2SAT datasets, and the featured-generation extension (per customized_models.py) runs end-to-end - Jorge's run_featured.sh port generates graphs with node/edge features fully autoregressively.

Sanitized-stats training: Kofi signed off 4/7. On the index team's target profile, generated graphs match degree distribution within 2% KS distance and clustering coefficient within tolerance, but component-size distribution is off in the tail - BiGG under-produces the rare giant components that dominate capacity-test behavior.

Trade-off: we can oversample large-component training examples (Rosa has the reweighting ready, cheap fix, slightly distorts other marginals) or condition generation on component-size targets, which is cleaner but a ~3 week extension Jorge would have to build in May on top of integration.

Recommend we decide at Friday's sync.

Vera
